title: Recovered Femto sleeve operational contracts
scope: All 30 top-level variant/helper Python files classified; operational bodies and selected related test bodies read. Strategy-only formulas excluded by user scope. Shared engine/control/status/publisher bodies belong companion reviews.
review_method: Read-only original source and AST-unparsed complete named bodies; copied lifecycle bodies compared by normalized AST; exact Git blob identity and pinned line references validated. No module imports, broker calls, source modifications or historical test execution.

features.title: Explicit worker duties and bounded batch invocation
features.observed_mechanism: Runners expose separate rank/scan, fill, settle, daily, intraday, reconcile and status duties; each invocation returns. Cadences are external scheduler contracts rather than embedded model workers.
features.implementable_requirement: Configure durable jobs by duty, submission window and completion receipt; run independently of UI and distinguish deterministic job from reasoning agent.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned historical source; deployment and historical test execution unverified
features.transfer_status: operational infrastructure only; strategy rules, capital, position sizing defaults and numerical thresholds excluded

features.title: Per-runner books, client IDs and writer scopes
features.observed_mechanism: Shared wrappers instantiate Sleeve with separate names and CID prefixes; custom runners use their own hidden state, JSONL ledger and locks. Morning Dip and Legends share a broker symbol yet attribute owned fills separately.
features.implementable_requirement: Give each book/run/order an explicit identity; maintain local ownership independently from net broker position and use stable single-writer resource locks.
limits: Morning Dip main does not acquire a process-wide file lock in the reviewed body; do not infer universal locking from other runners.

features.title: Explicit option contracts and idempotent order intents
features.observed_mechanism: Bilbo uses OCC contract symbols, whole-contract quantities, buy_to_open/sell_to_close and deterministic hashed episode/exit CIDs; source restricts execution to paper.
features.implementable_requirement: When options support is configured, validate contract identity, multiplier, whole quantity and position intent, and persist account/book-scoped order identity before submission.
limits: Source strategy selection and premium allocation are excluded.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned historical source; deployment and historical test execution unverified

features.title: Options pending entry and exit lifecycle
features.observed_mechanism: Accepted entry becomes pending_entry; later broker fill confirms open. Accepted exit becomes pending_exit; the position moves to closed only after confirmation. Existing pending_exit is preserved during held-contract recovery.
features.implementable_requirement: Represent accepted, working, partial, terminal, uncertain and confirmed states explicitly; submission acknowledgment must not create/remove held positions.
limits: Option entry_premium_mid remains a sizing/reference quote, not a verified transaction cost basis.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned historical source; deployment and historical test execution unverified
features.transfer_status: operational infrastructure only; strategy rules, capital, position sizing defaults and numerical thresholds excluded

features.title: Terminal partial fills and residual exits
features.observed_mechanism: Phase adopts terminal entry/reentry partials, reduces stop/market-exit remainder and retains protection retry. Confluence restages residual sell quantity after a dead partial exit; Momentum/Beatendown differ. Working partial fills in the copied equity pending state machines wait for terminal status.
features.implementable_requirement: Import cumulative filled quantity, notional and fee deltas exactly once immediately on observation, retain residual intent and ensure coverage matches actual remaining holdings.
limits: Behavior is not uniform across runner families; source test presence is not proof every family handles a case.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned historical source; deployment and historical test execution unverified
features.transfer_status: operational infrastructure only; strategy rules, capital, position sizing defaults and numerical thresholds excluded

features.title: Bounded exit repricing with manual-review retention
features.observed_mechanism: Bilbo retains unfilled exits, obtains new two-sided quotes, attempts bounded cancel-replace repricing and raises a persistent manual-review flag when retry allowance is exhausted.
features.implementable_requirement: Configure bounded cancel/replace retries, verify cancellation and quantity before replacement, retain unresolved holdings and generate actionable escalation without inventing a fill.
limits: Bilbo cancellation helpers do not verify terminal cancellation before replacement; improve this rather than copying the race. Log escalation alone does not establish delivered notification.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned historical source; deployment and historical test execution unverified
features.transfer_status: operational infrastructure only; strategy rules, capital, position sizing defaults and numerical thresholds excluded

features.title: Multi-leg submission and uncertain acceptance recovery
features.observed_mechanism: Actual SPX entry calls atomic mleg despite the older header describing separate entry legs. After submit error/bad shape it searches exact CID across open and closed orders; unreadable lists prevent concluding no order exists. Cancel failure retains pending_unverified for later verification.
features.implementable_requirement: Prefer supported atomic multi-leg submission; journal acceptance uncertainty, lookup the same CID, and keep unknown orders in durable reconciliation rather than duplicating or declaring failure.
limits: No strategy, underlying, width or account floor is imported. Successful cancel request is not followed by cancellation confirmation in every entry branch.
features.current_status: implemented in pinned historical source; deployment and historical test execution unverified
features.transfer_status: operational infrastructure only; strategy rules, capital, position sizing defaults and numerical thresholds excluded

features.title: Actual broker close versus explicit modeled settlement
features.observed_mechanism: SPX records broker_close when both close legs are confirmed, otherwise retains incomplete/unverifiable legs. A broker-flat post-expiry path uses marked settled_proxy derived from market data.
features.implementable_requirement: Distinguish verified execution P&L from modeled settlement, retain valuation source/date/cost assumptions, and keep incomplete or unknown legs visible for reconciliation.
limits: Entry credit is derived from quote context rather than imported leg fill notional. The referenced regression is a source-pattern check, not a full broker-close behavior test.

features.transfer_status: operational infrastructure only; strategy rules, capital, position sizing defaults and numerical thresholds excluded

features.title: Direct parent-order truth for generated bracket legs
features.observed_mechanism: Morning Dip resolves the bracket parent by owned CID and GETs the parent because list responses can return legs=null. Broker-generated child IDs are related by parent identity, not by bare symbol/side.
features.implementable_requirement: Fetch expanded parent/child order details when list views omit legs; retain parent-child identity and deduplicate the same fill visible in several reads.

features.title: Shared-symbol ownership and conflicting net exposure
features.observed_mechanism: Morning Dip owns verified entry fills minus its parent legs/scoped closes. Legends attributes same-day prefix closing fills and clamps close/protection quantity to matching broker direction. Manual and another sleeve orders are excluded.
features.implementable_requirement: Maintain book-level ownership and broker-level net separately; never cancel or close by symbol alone; detect conflicting/net-divergent ownership and stop conflicting mutation.
limits: Attribution inference relies on bounded order history and can fail when old fills disappear or generated OCO legs are not expanded.

features.title: Persisted explicit close intent and retry identity
features.observed_mechanism: Morning Dip writes closing CID/quantity/reason/submitted=False before broker POST, marks receipt separately, and reuses its CID on failure. Working close is left intact; state persists until observed closure.
features.implementable_requirement: Write ahead the close intent, make retry identity stable, refresh broker truth after cancellations and use confirmed remaining quantity for retries.

features.title: Verified OCO replacement and tracked protection gap
features.observed_mechanism: Legends checks current protection, validates response and observes exact new OCO live before marking protected. Replacement waits until the old OCO disappears, stores refresh_pending/refresh_since and escalates stale gaps.
features.implementable_requirement: Model protection replacement as cancel-requested, cancel-confirmed, replacement-submitted and live; expose gap age and avoid stacking coverage orders.
limits: Existing protection detection tests closing-side prefix orders rather than proving complete OCO leg quantity/price coverage; preserve this limitation.

features.title: Missing-stop recovery with fresh replacement identity
features.observed_mechanism: Phase/Phoenix preserve held positions when initial stop fails, flag missing protection for retry, reject malformed/terminal stop responses and rotate retry CID so idempotency does not return a dead old order.
features.implementable_requirement: Protect only confirmed held quantity; retain held positions through protection failure; use fresh replacement identity linked to original intent and verify live covered quantity.
limits: Phase/Phoenix existence checks do not comprehensively verify price/covered quantity; source stop levels are excluded.

features.implementable_requirement: Schedule urgent reconcile/protection work independently from research/data scans and keep it serviceable during entry pause or research failures.

features.title: Stop/exit races and parked orphan cancellation
features.observed_mechanism: Phase verifies stop cancellation and parks orphan_stop for retry. Phoenix delays time exit if its stop cannot be verified gone, suppresses stop rearm while exit working and sweeps sibling stops after closure.
features.implementable_requirement: Track surviving orders after close, honor fills from superseded orders and park unresolved cancellations with retry/escalation; never treat cancellation request as proof protection is gone.

features.title: Session-aware close and explicit pending flatten verification
features.observed_mechanism: Legends queries session close, advances close on early-close day and uses a conservative early close when calendar unavailable. flat_pending verifies broker net and waits for working close before retry/clearing.
features.implementable_requirement: Use exchange-calendar close and persisted pending-close end-state verification; report unknown calendar and missed end-state rather than claiming submission means flat.
limits: Several other variant runners gate only weekdays/hardcoded RTH; do not imply one universal holiday/early-close implementation.

features.title: Completed versus provisional data boundaries
features.observed_mechanism: Phase excludes today from completed daily bars; Phoenix separates include_forming data for detection from completed signals; Morning Dip waits until a three-minute candle is closed; hourly wrappers filter session grids and completed hours.
features.implementable_requirement: Record bar start/end, session, adjustment and feed, and explicitly separate provisional observations from completed research data.
limits: Different scripts use SIP/IEX and split/all/raw adjustment; this is explicit source heterogeneity, not a unified data-truth contract.

features.implementable_requirement: Bound/paginate external reads, retain sufficient history and data lineage, isolate symbol failures and give missing critical dependency a visible non-success state.

features.title: Pending commitments and projected global exposure
features.observed_mechanism: Confluence/Beatendown capacity subtract pending entries; custom TS fill uses projected desk exposure plus accepted intra-pass notional and fail-closes if exposure module unavailable. Entry risk/context checks remain separate from existing exits.
features.implementable_requirement: Use current broker/readiness truth and atomic pending reservations across books; separate capacity, hard limits and advisory risk observations, with operator-configured policy.
limits: Source risk constants and allocations excluded. Separate read/check followed by submit is not an atomic reservation across processes.

features.title: Distinguish entry halt from research-only pause
features.observed_mechanism: Phoenix entries_paused blocks entries while exits/protection continue; Morning Dip TRADING_ENABLED=False dispatches a signal-only pass that deliberately omits protective management unless --force. Both states are explicit in code/tests.
features.implementable_requirement: Make entry halt, servicing-only, research-only and shutdown distinct controls; existing lifecycle servicing must remain active unless operator intentionally chooses a different mode.
limits: Historical approval text is evidence only; it does not impose a new permission workflow on the current user.

features.title: Atomic snapshots and honest corrupt-state recovery
features.observed_mechanism: Options/Phase/Phoenix/intraday files flush/fsync a temporary JSON snapshot and rotate backups; several preserve corrupt bytes and flag recovery. Some start blank rather than reconstructing complete books; copied momentum-family writes lack the stronger fsync/backup behavior.
features.implementable_requirement: Use durable transactional execution state, explicit new-book initialization and last-valid recovery; preserve corruption and block new commitments until holdings/intent ownership is reconstructed.
limits: Per-runner JSONL logging is not universally fsynced or hash-chained. Backup existence alone does not prove automatic complete recovery.

features.title: Dry-run side-effect boundaries are explicit per duty
features.observed_mechanism: Bilbo/SPX/Phase/Phoenix logger prints only in DRY_RUN and state save skips. Shared wrapper dry-run often logs/locks and may fetch; TS rank always saves shared cache via fetch_bars despite dry_run. Source tests cover selected paths only.
features.implementable_requirement: Give simulated/replay/dry-run jobs isolated stores and declared permitted reads; verify no broker mutations or production execution/account/message writes in dry-run.
limits: A --dry-run flag is not proof of whole-program purity across all variants.

features.implementable_requirement: Persist scheduled period/slot attempts and stage-specific success receipts; incomplete or failed effects remain retryable rather than equating function return to completed rebalance.

features.title: Unknown reads remain distinct from empty/flat
features.observed_mechanism: Morning Dip rejects malformed non-list orders/positions as None. Phase critical stale-intent cleanup requires both open and closed book reads; options spread lookup returns a dedicated unreadable sentinel.
features.implementable_requirement: Validate broker response shapes and use typed unknown/not-configured/empty outcomes; never clear intent, book or protection merely because a dependency read failed.
limits: Other lenient source helper paths do return [] on failure; strict behavior is not universal.

features.title: Recovered holdings preserve uncertain basis and ownership
features.observed_mechanism: Phoenix reconstructs aged-out pending entries from broker quantity and an explicitly approximate reference price; today-scoped Legends/Morning Dip recovery searches owned fill identity. Phoenix broker-flat exit recovery substitutes entry price and orphan-short cleanup assumes broker net ownership.
features.implementable_requirement: Adopt only with explicit account/order ownership evidence; retain observed cost and provenance, keep unknown basis/strategy/protection unknown and prevent invented realized P&L.
limits: Synthetic zero-return broker-flat recovery and automatic net-short ownership assumptions are explicit source limitations to avoid.
